_comment: Hand-reviewed exceptions to the generic HYPERUI_GROUP_SECTION_KIND / FAMILY_SECTION_TYPE_KIND tables in scripts/build-catalog.ts, keyed by the final entry id. Each key must match a generated entry or build-catalog.ts throws — this file cannot silently go stale. Keep it short: an entry belongs here only when the table's generic reading of its group/type is clearly wrong for this specific section, not as a place to re-derive the whole catalog by hand.

family-section:emmpo:emmpo-career._why: The 'career quiz' callout is a promotional call to action, not a feature list — the generic emmpo type table has no entry for 'career', so this overrides the 'unclassified' fallback.

family-section:emmpo:emmpo-social._why: The social gallery shows finished/past work images, closer to a proof gallery than a generic list.

family-section:halcyon:now-showing._why: The current-exhibit showcase is a gallery of what's on display, not a generic feature list.

family-section:maren:care._why: Care instructions read as exact-figure/technical spec content (materials, cleaning, handling), closer to specifications than a generic section.

family-section:nonprofit:nonprofit-stori._why: First-person impact stories are attributed personal accounts, structurally closest to testimonials even though the taxonomy definition names customers rather than beneficiaries.

family-section:nonprofit:nonprofit-accou._why: The financial/accountability breakdown states exact figures (fund allocation, ratios), matching the 'specifications' definition better than any other taxonomy id.
